plugins.prepareCmd: printf '# Lo reescribe semantic-release en cada release (.releaserc, @semantic-release/exec).\n__version__ = "${nextRelease.version}"\n' > src/fogar_gateway/_version.py && uv export --frozen --no-dev --no-emit-project --no-hashes -o constraints.txt && sed -i "s/^FOGAR_RELEASE=.*/FOGAR_RELEASE=${nextRelease.version}/" install.sh && sh scripts/build-web.sh && uv build --wheel -o dist

assets.label: Paquete con la web (lo instala install.sh)
